nodes.description: BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): sends tokens from msg.sender to _to, guarded by require checks.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner): read-only view returning balances[_owner].
BasicToken.totalSupply(): read-only view returning totalSupply_.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens using allowance.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowance for msg.sender.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender): reads allowed mapping.
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds to existing allowance.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtracts from allowance with branch.
CRMTToken.changeOwner(address _to): onlyOwner; moves balances to new owner and reassigns owner without zero-address check.
CRMTToken.mint(address _to, uint256 _amount): onlyOwner; inflates totalSupply_ and recipient balance.
CRMTToken.burn(uint256 _value): onlyOwner; destroys tokens from msg.sender balance and totalSupply_.
CRMTToken constructor: payable, sets balances[owner] = 0.
mapping(address => uint256) balances: token balances keyed by address.
uint256 totalSupply_: total token supply, mutated by mint and burn.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed: nested allowance mapping.
address public owner: privileged address controlling mint/burn/changeOwner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for auth checks and as a mapping key.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer: arithmetic state mutation on sender balance.
balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer: arithmetic state mutation on recipient balance.
balances[_from].sub(_value) in transferFrom: arithmetic state mutation without allowance re-check on write.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom: arithmetic allowance decrement.
totalSupply_.add(_amount) in mint: arithmetic inflation of total supply by privileged caller.
balances[burner].sub(_value) in burn: arithmetic balance decrement.
totalSupply_.sub(_value) in burn: arithmetic supply decrement.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue): arithmetic allowance increment.
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) in decreaseApproval: arithmetic allowance decrement.
owner = _to in changeOwner: privileged ownership transfer with no zero-address validation.
balances[_to] = balances[owner]; balances[owner] = 0 in changeOwner: forced balance migration.
Parameter _to of transfer(): recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(): amount to transfer.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf(): address queried.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(): source address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(): destination address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(): amount moved.
Parameter _spender of approve(): allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _value of approve(): allowance amount.
Parameter _owner of allowance(): token owner queried.
Parameter _spender of allowance(): spender queried.
Parameter _spender of increaseApproval().
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval(): allowance increment.
Parameter _spender of decreaseApproval().
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval(): allowance decrement.
Local uint oldValue caching allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in decreaseApproval.
Parameter _to of changeOwner(): new owner address.
Parameter _to of mint(): recipient of minted tokens.
Parameter _amount of mint(): amount created.
Parameter _value of burn(): amount destroyed.
